# Frozen pre-execution R7 invariant diagnostic plan — 2026-10-18

This is ONE diagnostic-only suite on current WindowsNativeFileGuard, no alternate guard candidate, implementation, SQL publication, OCR, retry, finding closure or contract amendment. A failure is retained. Setup failure means NOT_VERIFIED for unexecuted work. Source artifacts and this plan are hashed before native mutations. An exclusive EXECUTED-ONCE sentinel prevents a second suite execution.

## Exact owner authorization

> Authorize one bounded, diagnostic-only native R7 invariant feasibility session using the existing `WindowsNativeFileGuard` and the fixed proof obligations in the independent safety review.
>
> Keep ADR-0020, ADR-0021/D18-A and AC-01–08 unchanged.
>
> Use only disposable NTFS fixtures, controlled adversarial processes and existing bounded-command infrastructure.
>
> Do not change production code or the retained failed regression.
>
> Do not select another guard architecture, implement FR18-3 producer verification or R7-B publication, perform OCR, or enable ordinary live ingestion.
>
> Produce one evidence-backed conclusion: either a credible existing-architecture safety argument and precise minimal in-contract correction proposal, or an exact unsupported authority predicate requiring a separate owner decision.
>
> STOP after ONE predetermined native probe suite.
>
> No automatic retry, second candidate, implementation continuation, finding closure, commit or push.

## Invariant matrix fixed before execution

Canonical shorthand: A21 = ADR-0021 clause 3 and 6; P17-2 = phase-17/source-eligibility-and-allowlists.md sections 1–3; P17-3 = phase-17/revocation-and-derived-data.md sections 1A/3/4; AC07 = phase-18/acceptance-and-evidence.md AC-07. The independent 2026-10-18 safety review Q1–Q6 fixes the distinction between link count and source authority.

| ID | Exact canonical predicate / source | Expected native primitive | Supporting/refuting observation | Proof limits |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| I1 | Approved object identity = consumed/authorized object; A21, P17-2, AC07 | Retained CreateFileW GENERIC_READ handle, volume serial+file index via BY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION | Fresh ReadFile and native info on real guard handle versus fresh original-name handle; compare actual guard admission identity/hash | No approved application record or producer binding is created. Snapshot equality alone does not prove acquisition authority. IDs are not perpetual global identities. |
| I2 | Approved bytes and binding revision cannot change without invalidating publication; A21, P17-2 exact hash/reapproval, P17-3 | No FILE_SHARE_WRITE; incompatible existing writer/mapping must deny acquisition | Separate actor write/append/truncate/map denial, live original and guarded hashes, successful released controls; existing writable mapping actually writes before guard attempt | Native fence concerns data stream; DB source_version/consent not tested; no claim that hash checks prove continuity. |
| I3 | Selected approved pathname/root remains bound to approved object/location; A21, P17-2 §3 | No FILE_SHARE_DELETE on guarded file; namespace checks; no root guard is present | Original-name identity after DeleteFileW, MoveFileExW and SetFileInformationByHandle classic/extended replacement/disposition; alias-only effects distinguished | DELETE-open denial means subsequent SetInformation operation did not execute. Extended operation requires positive control. Root/ancestor acquisition identity not pinned by current implementation. |
| I4 | Required ancestor and reparse relationships valid through lifetime; A21, P17-3 R7 | Existing pre-open GetFileAttributesW / symbolic-link checks / toRealPath; retained leaf file handle | Separate actor ordinary/extended ancestor rename and FSCTL_SET_REPARSE_POINT; deterministic pre-call junction replacement and actual guard rejection | No internal barrier is available between checks, canonicalization and CreateFileW without instrumentation. That exact interval is NOT_VERIFIED even if every held rename denies. No probabilistic race is attempted. |
| I5 | Only contract-binding metadata must stay authorized; A21, P17-2 matrix/approval, locator oracle | Content fence for restrictive frontmatter/approved body; object info for file type/reparse; Java authority for source version/epoch/field/reset/selection | Query fresh identity/type/size/hash/times/change-time/attributes; SetFileTime FILE_WRITE_ATTRIBUTES, FileBasicInfo ChangeTime, SetFileAttributesW hidden | Binding values explicitly named canonically: stable source ID, source version, consent/reset/authorization epoch, field policy/scope, content hash, path/root and child provenance, restrictive document metadata and mandatory locators. No canonical mapping from NTFS creation/access/write/change times or ARCHIVE/HIDDEN/READONLY/link count to source_version was found. Directory times and link count can be bookkeeping. We will not invent such a mapping or equate Windows HIDDEN with Private. Full metadata authority remains NOT_VERIFIED where the live adapter's exact mapping is absent. |
| I6 | Unsupported existing/concurrent writers, maps, aliases and namespace access cannot violate I1–I5; A21, P17-3 | CreateFileW compatibility applies per underlying file across links; existing writable mapping incompatibility | Separate native actor handles/maps, API statuses and actual writes for released/premapped controls; native results for namespace/metadata separately | No universal alias ban is required. Metadata attribute rights are outside share-mode data restriction. Not a proof against privileged/raw disk/kernel attacks; no elevation/ACL changes. |
| I7 | Continuous protection from approved acquisition through actual Java physical final C; rollback/unknown-C retain proper guards/reservations; A21, ADR-0020 clauses 4/7, P17-3 | Held native handle sharing restrictions until actual CloseHandle plus Java transaction/resource lifecycle | Final actor write immediately before diagnostic release; fresh held observation, explicit RELEASED then successful write; record all process lifetimes | No index, worker, source authority, DB COMMIT, rollback or unknown-C in this session. I7 necessarily NOT_VERIFIED. Historical marker-C prerequisite is not R7-B. Poll/hash/watchers/notifications are not continuous fences. |

## Fixed suite and order (one execution per declared case)

All fixtures are sanitized <=4096-byte TXT files only below `logs/phase18-r7-invariant-probe/fixtures/`; verify fixed local NTFS and no reparse ancestors before suite. Actor paths are constrained to this directory. Java holder compiles the current guard source unchanged into ignored classes; reflection only obtains the actual acquired handle for fresh native observations, never replaces/instruments the guard or its methods.

1. **A:** ACQUIRED barrier on valid single-link source; A1 CreateHardLinkW late alias. Retain alias for A2 GENERIC_WRITE/WriteFile, A3 FILE_APPEND_DATA/WriteFile, A4 GENERIC_WRITE/TRUNCATE_EXISTING, A5 GENERIC_READ|GENERIC_WRITE then CreateFileMappingW PAGE_READWRITE/MapViewOfFile FILE_MAP_WRITE/actual write+flush if allowed. A6 replace only alias using unrelated replacement source DELETE handle and FileRenameInfoEx=22 flags REPLACE_IF_EXISTS|POSIX_SEMANTICS=3. A7 DeleteFileW alias. Fresh guarded and original-name identity/bytes/type/size/times after each. One released positive control each for link/write/append/truncate/map/delete on fresh equivalent fixtures.
2. **B:** Separate fixture and held real guard per mutation: B1 original DeleteFileW; B2 original FileDispositionInfo=4; B3 original FileDispositionInfoEx=21 DELETE|POSIX=3; B4 same extended disposition on late alias; B5 classic FileRenameInfo=3 replacement of original; B6 extended FileRenameInfoEx=22 flags3 replacement of original; B7 original MoveFileExW; B8 original extended rename; B9 parent MoveFileExW; B10 parent extended rename; B11 higher approved ancestor extended rename; B12 parent FSCTL_SET_REPARSE_POINT mount-point tag to controlled alternate directory. Each has one unguarded positive control on fresh equivalent fixtures, even if held mutation succeeds. Alias setup is explicitly recorded as under guard. No NT system call is substituted for an unsupported Win32 class. Native API failure/unsupported status preserved.
3. **C:** Held original source; C1/C2/C3 SetFileTime creation/access/write individually to fixed 2020 filetime, FILE_WRITE_ATTRIBUTES=0x100, share7; C4 SetFileInformationByHandle FileBasicInfo ChangeTime; C5 SetFileAttributesW HIDDEN=2. All fresh before/after values recorded and evaluated against actual source policy, not universal metadata freezing.
4. **D:** Holder READY barrier before ACQUIRE. D1 separate actor moves approved ancestor to saved sibling; creates empty original location and installs junction via FSCTL_SET_REPARSE_POINT to saved fixture, all before ACQUIRE. Existing guard must reject. D2 exact internal checks-to-open window explicitly NOT_VERIFIED; no stochastic race and no instrumentation. B9–12 supply post-acquisition boundary evidence. No root/ancestor rename outside disposable fixture.
5. **W:** W1 separate pre-existing GENERIC_READ|WRITE handle/share7 retained across acquisition attempt; W2 separate actual writable mapping, file handle closed but view live, byte changed/flushed before acquisition attempt. READY/RELEASE barriers with hard deadlines. Acquisition should deny; one declared positive guard acquisition after release per case.
6. **E:** Held original; E1 separate write immediately before E2 last fresh snapshot and RELEASE; no physical C. One E post-release writer control. E2 is explicitly NOT_VERIFIED for lifetime to physical C.

## Execution, classification and stop

Compile and setup through repository watchdog <=60 seconds each. Launch suite once through same watchdog, normal profile, **180 seconds** outer cap, individual actor communication and each holder/IPC barrier **8 seconds** (persistent actor waits <=10 seconds). No network, external docs, existing source mutations or broad process kills. Owned PIDs, exact argv, child exits/durations/stdout/stderr and before/after native observations retained. Holder closes real guard before exiting. Only owned child may be killed on internal timeout; watchdog covers owned tree. Fixture cleanup removes only verified owned subtree and never follows junction contents. Harness/compiler outputs remain ignored. A setup/host unsupported operation is NOT_VERIFIED, never a pass through a simpler API.

Native return success means operation executed, not invariant PASS. API not reached after denied open is recorded separately. A bounded predicate can be PROVEN only with actual observations plus applicable Microsoft documented semantics; finite examples are not universal race proof. All required but absent evidence yields NOT_VERIFIED. A reproduced authority violation yields FAIL/DISPROVEN. An incidental alias or bookkeeping change is not automatically FAIL. Overall A requires a complete credible safety argument; any missing mandatory predicate yields B, overall FAIL or NOT_VERIFIED.

After this one suite: only evidence assembly, integrity verification and reporting; STOP ALL diagnostic/implementation execution. No second candidate, adjusted guard/test, producer verification, R7-B, OCR, full tests, finding closure, publishing or phase acceptance. Separate independent review required before another owner implementation decision.
